DEGRADED SIGNAL. VEP's built-in CLIN_SIG is declared but never populated on CHM13 (its cache carries no ClinVar), so this custom-annotation field is the only source. Unlike CLIN_SIG it reports ClinVar's single aggregate classification rather than every submission, so a variant with conflicting submissions appears as e.g. Benign instead of benign&pathogenic. On GRCh38 that difference lost 10 of 12 Pathogenic matches, so the canonical mapping deliberately keeps CLIN_SIG; expect hs1 runs to under-report conflicting-submission pathogenic variants.
